_note: Catalogue entries are DECLARED facts (with source). Live status is measured separately by D1 and never copied from here.

tools.name: OpenAI API
tools.permissions: API key with access to the chosen model
tools.cost: Usage-billed per token; rate card must be read from the live pricing page. DevPilot records measured token usage per run.

tools.name: GitHub (gh CLI / REST)
tools.permissions: repo scope (contents + pull requests write) on the target repository
tools.cost: No per-call charge for REST/CLI use; plan limits and rate limits apply.

tools.name: Google Drive
tools.cost: Drive API has no per-call fee; quota limits apply.

tools.name: Git
tools.purpose: Local change tracking (not a hosting service)
tools.permissions: Write access to the working directory

tools.name: Python unittest / pytest
tools.purpose: Automated tests (a pass is evidence, not proof)

tools.name: Docker
tools.permissions: Access to the Docker daemon (equivalent to root on the host: restrict it)
tools.cost: Engine is free; Docker Desktop licence terms depend on organisation size.
